seo.title: Atlaxys Consulting | Software Development & AI in Morocco
seo.description: Atlaxys Consulting builds web platforms, mobile apps, business software and AI automations for companies in Morocco and abroad, and supports them after launch.

hero.title: We build the software your business *runs on*.
hero.lead: Atlaxys is a software development and technology consulting company based in Morocco. We plan your project, build the software, automate repetitive tasks and keep everything running after launch, for businesses in Morocco and abroad.

statement.text: We are consultants who also write the code. We take the time to understand your problem, plan the solution with you, build it, and stay after launch to keep it running and improve it. You work with the same team from the first meeting onwards.

services.title: Four services. One team.
services.intro: Most projects need more than one of these. The people who plan your system are the same people who build it and look after it.

process.title: From first conversation to launch, and after.
process.intro: A step-by-step process that brings risks to the surface early, while they are still cheap to fix.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: We learn how your business works, who will use the software, what already exists and what constraints apply. Before giving any estimate, we make sure we are solving the right problem.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: We design how the system will work: the data, the connections to your other tools and the hosting. Each important choice is written down with its pros and cons, so you can question it.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We work in short cycles. Every one to two weeks, you get a new working version on a private test site that you can try yourself.

steps.title: Launch
steps.text: Releases are automated and tested, and monitoring and alerts are in place before real users arrive.

steps.title: Support
steps.text: We stay on for fixes, improvements, hosting cost reviews and the next features. Or we hand everything over to your team, with documentation they can actually use.

work.title: Real problems, explained step by step.
work.intro: Each case study explains the problem, the technical approach and the trade-offs, not just the screenshots.

products.title: We also build our own software.
products.intro: Alongside client projects, we build and maintain our own software products for specific needs, held to the same standards as our client work.

stack.title: Proven tools, chosen for good reasons.
stack.intro: We prefer mature, widely used technology, so your software stays easy to maintain and you can find developers for it later. We only use newer tools when they clearly pay off.

industries.title: Sectors we build for.
industries.intro: Our services are not tied to one industry. These sectors share the everyday needs our software addresses: scheduling, stock, payments, documents and customer communication. If yours is not listed, the underlying problems are often the same.

principles.title: What it is like to work with us.

items.title: We plan before we code
items.text: Every project starts with a written plan you can read, question and keep. Decisions are documented, so knowledge never stays in one person's head.

items.title: You own everything
items.text: The code, hosting accounts, domain names and data are registered to your company from day one. You are never locked in.

items.title: Done means live and in use
items.text: A demo is not a finished product. We consider work done when it is live, monitored and used by real people.

items.title: Direct contact with the builders
items.text: You talk to the people doing the work, in plain language and in English, French or Arabic, without a chain of account managers in between.

items.title: Convenient time zone
items.text: Morocco's time zone overlaps with most of the European working day and the North American morning, so meetings are easy to schedule.

insights.title: Practical guides on software, AI and costs.

items.question: What does Atlaxys Consulting do?
items.answer: Atlaxys Consulting is a software development and technology consulting company based in Morocco. We build web applications, mobile apps, business software (such as management and back-office tools) and AI automations, and we set up and maintain the cloud hosting they run on. We also help companies make technical decisions, such as whether to build or buy a system and how to modernise an existing one.

items.question: Where is Atlaxys based, and do you work with international clients?
items.answer: We are based in Morocco and work with clients in Morocco and abroad. Most collaboration happens remotely, by video call, email and WhatsApp, with on-site meetings when a project needs them.

items.question: Which languages do you work in?
items.answer: English, French and Arabic. We build software interfaces in all three, including right-to-left Arabic. Technical documentation is written in English by default, or in the language your team prefers.

items.question: How much does a software project cost?
items.answer: It depends on what the software needs to do, how many other tools it must connect to and how much is still undecided. After a short call, we send a written estimate with a price range and the assumptions behind it, so you can see exactly what drives the cost.

items.question: Do we own the code and the infrastructure?
items.answer: Yes. The code, hosting accounts, domain names and data are set up in your company's name. You can keep working with us, bring the work in-house or move to another provider at any time.

items.question: Can you take over or modernise an existing system?
items.answer: Yes. We start with a technical review of the code, hosting, security and release process. We then propose a step-by-step plan that improves the system while your business keeps running.

cta.title: Have something to build?
cta.text: Tell us what you are working on. You will hear back from the people who would build it, usually within one working day.
